name: Schmidt Science Fellows
funder: Schmidt Science Fellows (Schmidt Sciences, with the Rhodes Trust)
amount: USD 100,000 stipend (per academicpositions.com; confirm current value)
other_rules: Must be nominated by your PhD-awarding institution (a nominating partner)
PhD requirements, including defence, completed within the window set for each cohort (2027 cohort: 1 May 2026 to 30 Jun 2027)
PhD in astronomy, biology, chemistry, physics, earth sciences, engineering, mathematics or computing
fellows must pivot to a new field
social/political science and economics PhDs and clinical-track MD-PhD or veterinary-PhD applicants typically ineligible
notes: 2027 cohort: institutional nominations by 15 May 2026, preliminary information 1 Jun, full application 13 Jul 2026, interviews Aug 2026 to Feb 2027, selection March 2027, placements start July or October 2027. Placement can be anywhere in the world.
